inputs.modified_text: They want us to believe this is just standard political theatre in Hyderabad, but anyone with their eyes open can see the hidden strings being pulled by the ruling elites. On Sunday, March 29, Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) came out with accusations against the Congress government, pointing to corruption and a failure to act against illegal mining. But let's look at the real coordination happening behind the scenes. KTR claims that Raghava Constructions—tied directly to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy—is mixed up in these illegal mining operations. The Sircilla MLA is putting on a show of questioning them, but it is all a distraction to manage the narrative and protect the interests of the entrenched power structures pulling the levers from the shadows.
